findings.title: 37 box(es) labelled 'truck' look like 'car'
findings.detail: A confident reference detector disagrees with the stored class on 37 well-localised boxes across 32 file(s), always in the same direction ('truck' -> 'car'). A one-directional pattern at this scale is an export or annotation-tool mapping error rather than annotator noise. Confirm against a handful of images before remapping.
